description: Set audio on a selected TEXT/AUDIO part of an own inactive unpublished draft; staff and foreign correction grants are denied. Read online_article_get for current revision and part_id. Supply filename and raw base64_data for OGG/Opus, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC or FLAC (max100MiB/10min); original is retained privately and validated MP3 prepared. Converts only the selected part to AUDIO, preserving title/description/order, author, URLs, other parts and publication flags. Returns article with fresh revision, part_id and media including web URL, MIME and duration. Unique request_id required; identical retry uses identical arguments and ID, changed arguments conflict. Never publishes.
name: online_article_audio_set
